item: No official NBA, statute or press page could be re-read in this session
detail: Direct requests to www.nba.com, www.law.go.kr and www.espn.com returned no response (HTTP 000) from the sandbox used for this build (2026-11-05). The only reachable official endpoint was api.github.com. Every inherited official-source row on this site therefore remains at its earlier verification status and is NOT re-certified here; no value was copied forward as newly verified.
action_requested: Re-read the cited official pages from an environment with internet egress before treating any inherited row as verified.

item: NBA Terms of Use restrict gambling-related use and public reuse
detail: Sections 1 and 9 of the NBA Terms of Use restrict reuse/linking of Basketball Content and state that NBA Statistics may not be used in connection with gambling activity. This project computes statistical requirements only and publishes no NBA data or prices, but the restriction was NOT re-read this session (see L-01) and no permission or legal opinion exists.
action_requested: Obtain written permission and qualified legal review before any public gambling-related use of NBA content or statistics.

item: Four pull requests from other sessions are open and unmerged
detail: The published site on main does not contain the work in open PRs #23, #28, #31 and #37 (verified through the GitHub API on 2026-11-05). Their claims are not part of this site and were not merged or reviewed by this session.
action_requested: Decide which open PRs to merge; re-verify each on the combined tree first.

item: Two published pages had no inbound link
detail: docs/hub-evidence/index.html and docs/reverification/index.html were published but unreachable from any other published page. This session added additive links from the landing page (accepted as the integration change for its own section). The legacy calculator docs/dashboard.html remains deliberately unlinked (flag H01).

item: Broken relative link on the legacy calculator page
detail: docs/dashboard.html linked to `lab/`, a directory with no index.html, so the link 404s. It now points at `lab/overview.html`. The page is not linked from the landing page and no other content was changed.

item: Two published pages have no generator script in the tree
detail: docs/hub-evidence/index.html and docs/parlay-safety/index.html are hand-maintained rather than generated (the legacy root pages are likewise static and are labelled as such in the inventory). Their content is not reproducible by a script, so a data or link regression would not be caught by regeneration checks. Both pages are listed in the acceptance page inventory with a missing-generator marker.
action_requested: Record the generator for each hand-maintained page, or accept and document them as static.

item: The published requirements are arithmetic under stated assumptions
detail: Required sample sizes assume independent fixed-price bets, a known true edge, and a normal approximation. Real parlays and player-prop combinations are dependent: the parlay table uses an explicit independence baseline only. These numbers say how much evidence would be needed; they say nothing about whether any edge exists and are not performance forecasts.
action_requested: Re-derive the parlay rows with a measured dependence model before using them for sizing decisions.

item: No strategy is skill-eligible on the published data
detail: The bundled empirical ledger is empty and reports not_run. Zero strategies pass the gates, so no leaderboard entry, reward or line is asserted anywhere on this site. This is the intended fail-closed state, not an omission.

item: Merge commit SHAs quoted in the coordination board are not assessable here
detail: The clone used for this build is shallow (two commits), so a quoted historical SHA cannot be confirmed or refuted locally. The claim is recorded as not assessable rather than as verified.
action_requested: Confirm the quoted SHAs from a full clone before citing them as evidence.
